Ad: Kevin Trudeau shares a story about learning by watching.

His friend Mike Siegel is a ten-time world champion pool player. Kevin watched him shoot over and over until he played with the same mannerisms.

A stranger even noticed it and asked him about it. Then Kevin explains that Mike did the same thing as a kid, watching a legend named Irving Crane.

The lesson: you mimic and model successful behavior, and the best players learn it from the best.

Who are you studying right now?

#success #modeling #kevintrudeau

Ad: Kevin Trudeau shares a story about attitude from a pro pool match.

He and world champion Mike Siegel were watching a match. One player was tied and his opponent had the break, the big advantage. The man next to them said it was over.

Mike disagreed: anything could happen, he could even scratch on the break. Then that is exactly what happened, and the other player came back and won.

Mike called it the difference between a champion and a loser. Kevin says he never thought he was out of it either.

Do you keep believing until the final shot?

#mindset #champion #kevintrudeau
